title: Northern Samar boosts salt production, coastal livelihoods

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Northern Samar is expanding its community-based salt production industry to create additional livelihood opportunities for coastal residents and strengthen the province’s local salt supply amid the country’s continued dependence on imported salt. The provincial government, through its Provincial Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office (Pedipo), is providing local producers with equipment, production materials, technical assistance, and appropriate technology to improve salt production and develop their enterprises. Three towns—Bobon, San Vicente, and San Roque—have been identified as potential salt-producing areas, with the industry starting in Bobon in 2024 and more recently expanding to San Roque.
